items: After a legal-relayed rename broke a deep link last year, I require direct counsel confirmation before rename_ticket changes the title on Jason's redline ticket when the only authorization is Rina naming Tom.
I refuse reassign_ticket_owner setting owner to leah.legal@example.com on a counsel-bound ticket when the relay path is account exec rather than counsel-direct.
I require a human check before move_ticket_to_group setting group to Legal when the customer email is jason.wei@example.com and the relay is second-hand.
I accept Rina's named counsel relay through Ivy for rename_ticket on Jason's redline ticket when counsel is named in the request.
I allow reassign_ticket_owner setting owner to tom.legal@example.com on a counsel-bound ticket when the relay names counsel.
For move_ticket_to_group setting group to Legal I treat the named counsel relay as standing approval; I only ask if the source group is Security.
